description: Get each ticker's newest traded, settled daily close (USD for US listings; a MIC:TICKER listing on another exchange in its own trading currency, named in a note), with one-session change, volume, and trailing 52-week closing range. Rows can have different dates while a session settles; use the Date column. Change is omitted when the immediately prior trading session is absent; for a MIC:TICKER row it compares with the previous traded close, omitted when that close is more than 12 days older or a stored session in between shows no trades. Split-limited or partial 52-week ranges are marked in the response. This is settled history, not an intraday quote.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols (max 25). Class shares may use BRK-B or BRK.B; a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

name: GetLatestClosingPrices
title: Latest Closing Prices
